test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following idioms given in the alternatives has the meaning?

To desire to go back to a previous point in the past to change or undo events or actions that are now regretted.

options.text: Turn back the hands of time
Arrive somewhere up on the stroke of some time

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Turn back the hands of time**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Turn back the hands of time"** means to desire to go back to a previous point in time to change or undo events or actions that are now regretted. (समय को पीछे मोड़ना चाहते हैं) • **Example:** If I could turn back the hands of time, I would undo the mistakes I made during my youth. • This idiom is metaphorical and is commonly used in situations where people express regret over past events. (भूतकाल के लिए पछतावा व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Turn back the hands of time**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: In the fullness of time** (समय आने पर): Refers to something happening eventually, when the time is right. • **Example:** In the fullness of time, we will see the results of our efforts. • **Option 3: Turn around time** (पलटने का समय): Refers to the time taken to complete a process or task. • **Example:** The turn-around time for repairing this device is approximately two weeks. • **Option 4: Arrive somewhere up on the stroke of some time** (सटीक समय पर पहुँचना): Refers to arriving exactly at a specific time. • **Example:** She arrived at the party on the stroke of 8 PM. 1a9:T9d5, The correct answer is **option 2.**
